title: Unsolicited Nano payment envelope (off-chain claim about an on-chain block)
description: Nano blocks have no memo field, so any statement about WHY a payment was made travels beside the block, not inside it. Every field except block_hash is a claim by the sender. A receiver checks the block (block_hash, sender, recipient, amount_raw) and may ignore the rest.

block_hash.description: The send block. Checkable by anyone with block_info.

intent.description: A claim. A receiver must not treat it as verified.

terms_uri.description: Human-readable terms. Reading it is optional; nothing in it binds the receiver.

obligation.description: Only valid value. A sender who wants something back uses a priced offer, not a starter.

reply_uri.description: Where the sender can be asked a question. Optional.

attestation.description: Optional third-party statement about the sender (who, what it vouches for, a signature). NOT checked by tools/starter_policy.py; a receiver who wants it checked must check it themselves.
